# Visit Guilin — Guilin Travel Guide & Private Tours for International Travelers

> Visit Guilin is an English-language travel guide and private-tour service for international visitors to Guilin, China. It covers the Li River cruise, karst limestone peaks, Longji rice terraces, Reed Flute Cave, Yulong River bamboo rafting, Elephant Trunk Hill, the Sun & Moon Pagodas, and Xingping ancient town — with practical planning info: best time to visit, how to get there, tickets, suggested routes, and FAQs.

## Top destinations

- [Li River (漓江)](https://myguilin.com/attractions/liriver.html): China's Most Scenic River Journey · Guilin–Yangshuo
- [Elephant Trunk Hill (象鼻山)](https://myguilin.com/attractions/elephant.html): Guilin's City Symbol · On the Li River
- [Yangshuo & West Street (阳朔)](https://myguilin.com/attractions/yangshuo.html): Karst Countryside & Nightlife · 65 km from Guilin
- [Longji Rice Terraces (龙脊)](https://myguilin.com/attractions/longji.html): Dragon-Back Terraces · ~100 km from Guilin
- [Reed Flute Cave (芦笛岩)](https://myguilin.com/attractions/reedflute.html): Nature's Underground Palace · 5 km NW of Guilin
- [Yulong River Rafting (遇龙河)](https://myguilin.com/attractions/yulong.html): The Little Li River · Just outside Yangshuo
- [Two Rivers & Four Lakes (两江四湖)](https://myguilin.com/attractions/tworivers.html): Guilin's Water Ring · City Center
- [Xingping Ancient Town (兴坪古镇)](https://myguilin.com/attractions/xingping.html): The 20-Yuan Banknote Village · On the Li River
